beats.text: A signal reaches the Citadel. The shards are singing.
Howl at the monuments and gather the Echo Shards.
Shadow duplicates gather at the Gate. Reach it before the rift closes.

positions.title: Echo Shard 1
positions.lore: Each shard is a different sky and a different law.

positions.title: Echo Shard 2
positions.lore: No howl of significance shall be lost to time.

positions.title: Echo Shard 3
positions.lore: An Echo Shard carries not only what happened, but how it felt.

positions.title: Echo Shard 4
positions.lore: When the shards sing the same song, it hits like a cosmic EMP.

run.objective: Collect the Echo Shards, then reach the Eclipse Gate.

boss.name: Shadow Duplicates
boss.text: Shadow duplicates gather at the Gate. Reach it before the rift closes.

next_hook.teaser: Another signal answers from farther in.

truth.insight: The Star Core reveals: time is a spiral.
